messages:
matt (sales): ACME POC blocked. they pinned full id `redwood-qa-7b-v2` but it's not in eu-west-1. demo scheduled tomorrow, need options fast. :worried:
anya (solutions): do we know if v2 was intentionally omitted or just not replicated?
ken (infra): not replicated. replication job skipped v2 during last pass; v1 and q4 are present in eu-west. v2 lives in us-west only.
sam (eng-runtime): behavioral note: v1 tokenization differs on some punctuation; exact-match evals could diverge. v1 is otherwise functionally similar.
matt (sales): customer will run exact-match set — parity is a big ask. they may abort if results change.
anya (solutions): could we do cross-region routing for the demo and promise no logs leave EU? they said demo-only exception might work.
emily (security): temporary exception might be allowed if KMS stays in eu-west and telemetry/logging disabled. legal needs an addendum; require customer's KMS ARN and written approval.
ken (infra): pragmatic workaround: create alias `redwood-qa-7b-eu-demo` that points to us-west v2, disable telemetry/KV sync, and encrypt traffic with customer's EU KMS. Expect ~200-400ms extra latency.
sam (eng-runtime): alias will need model-id remap support in POC config. small DB migration + short deploy. estimate ~3-4 hours total including QA + rollback plan.
matt (sales): and about costs — cross-region egress? client asked who pays.
ken (infra): standard is to bill customer for egress. we can offer to absorb up to a capped amount for goodwill during POC.
matt (sales): propose two paths to ACME: A) alias+remap to preserve identical model id (4hr work, higher latency, egress absorbed up to $200), B) switch to in-region `v1` immediately (instant, possible eval drift). which do we recommend?
anya (solutions): offer both; position A as "parity demo" for extra confidence. include the caveat about latency and KMS addendum.
emily (security): I'll draft addendum checklist for legal: KMS ARN, authorized approver, telemetry disable confirmation, audit log retention.
sam (eng-runtime): I'll prepare the remap patch and a rollback script. tagging @ken for the DB migration window.
ken (infra): scheduling note: can do the migration at 11:00 UTC today; will ping when complete.
sre-bot: [INFO] INC-4321 opened: "ACME POC - region model mismatch / kms question" assigned infra, eng-runtime, security.
matt (sales): thanks team. I'll send ACME both options and request KMS ARN + confirmation on egress cap. will update INC-4321 with reply. :thumbsup:
anya (solutions): also suggest running a one-off eval to a shared bucket so they can see a diff report before the demo. reduces surprises.
matt (sales): adding that to the email now.
